title: polygala baetica var. sennenii
intro: Polygala baetica var. sennenii, commonly known as Spanish milkwort, is a plant species that belongs to the Polygalaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and inflammation, due to its purported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Polygala baetica var. sennenii include its immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory, and bronchodilatory effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of asthma and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
